cette_roue_est_une_representation_comple: This wheel is a complete representation of the sky at the precise moment of your birth. The outer ring displays the twelve zodiac signs, while the houses divide the different areas of your life. The symbols of the planets indicate their natal positions, and the lines at the center reveal the major astrological aspects, that is, the relationships between these different energies.
